description: EXIT PERFORM [CYCLE] (ISO §2023:14.9.14.2 Format 3 / §2023:14.9.14.4 GR5a) — a COBOL-2002 structured-procedure exit leaving (or cycling) the most closely preceding inline PERFORM; introduced 2002 (the 85 EXIT is only Format 1, §2023:14.9.14.3 SR1). CYCLE is confined to an inline PERFORM by §2023:14.9.14.3 SR8 and rides the same gate.
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.14.2 Format 3 / §2023:14.9.14.4 GR5a — COBOL-2002 structured-exit introduction (VCR has no 85→2002 rows; derived from the 2002 standard)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMEXPERF.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 N PIC 9 VALUE 0.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    PERFORM UNTIL N > 5
        ADD 1 TO N
        IF N = 3 EXIT PERFORM END-IF
    END-PERFORM.
    DISPLAY N.
    STOP RUN.
